neighbours.label: The piece 'ob' inside 'Chernobyl'
fire: The reactor at Chernobyl exploded in April 1986 and spread radiation across Europe.
Many villages near Chernobyl are still empty more than thirty years after the disaster.
Scientists study the wolves that now roam freely in the Chernobyl exclusion zone.
My grandmother remembers the news about Chernobyl coming on the radio that spring.
Tourists can now take guided tours of the abandoned town next to Chernobyl.
The amount released was about a tenth of what escaped from Chernobyl in 1986.
After Chernobyl, several countries decided to stop building new nuclear plants.
A new steel shelter was slid over the ruined Chernobyl reactor in 2016.
quiet: The reactor at Fukushima was damaged in March 2011 and leaked radiation into the sea.
Many villages near Fukushima are still empty more than ten years after the disaster.
Scientists study the wild boars that now roam freely in the Fukushima exclusion zone.
My grandmother remembers the news about Three Mile Island coming on the radio that spring.
Tourists can now take guided tours of the abandoned mining town in the mountains.
The amount released was about a tenth of what escaped from Fukushima in 2011.
After Fukushima, several countries decided to stop building new nuclear plants.
A new steel shelter was built over the ruined Fukushima reactor building in 2016.
